question: The population of a town increases by 8% annually. If the present population is 45,000, what will be its population after 2 years?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective percentage increase for 2 successive years = x + y + (x × y) ÷ 100

⇒ Effective increase = 8 + 8 + (8 × 8) ÷ 100 = 16.64%

⇒ Population after 2 years = Initial Population × (100% + 16.64%)

⇒ Population after 2 years = 45000 × 116.64% = 450 × 116.64 = 52,488

**∴ The correct answer is 52,488.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Population (P) = 45,000

Rate of increase (R) = 8%

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Population after T years = P × (1 + R ÷ 100)T
